video_summary.overall_goal: Open the app's scanner settings, review available scanning and content options by scrolling through the settings list, then return to the scan screen.
video_summary.description: The recording starts on a Scan code camera screen showing a crop region over a checkerboard-like target. The user opens the overflow menu, selects Settings, scrolls through multiple settings sections, and returns to the Scan code screen.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app is on a camera-based Scan code screen. A live camera preview fills most of the display with a rectangular crop region over a checkerboard-like target.
steps.system_response: The scan screen remains visible with the camera preview active.
steps.visual_feedback: Camera preview and scan overlay remain visible.
steps.intent_task: View or prepare the scanner screen before changing app options.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Scan code screen is still visible, and the overflow menu opens from the top-right corner.
steps.system_response: A menu opens over the camera preview.
steps.visual_feedback: A dark popup menu appears with scanner actions and Settings.
steps.intent_task: Open the app menu to access additional options.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The app navigates from the scan menu to the Settings screen. The top of the settings list is visible.
steps.navigation_change: Scan code screen to Settings screen
steps.visual_feedback: The camera preview is replaced by a dark Settings list with a back arrow.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The user scrolls down from the top scan settings into options related to scanning behavior and feedback.
steps.system_response: The settings list moves downward to reveal additional scan and feedback options.
steps.visual_feedback: The scrollbar position changes and new settings rows slide into view.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The user continues scrolling through settings sections for saving history, forwarding scans, and content handling.
steps.system_response: More settings rows and section labels become visible as the list scrolls.
steps.visual_feedback: The list content moves upward and the scrollbar advances downward.
steps.intent_task: Inspect content, history, and forwarding settings.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The user scrolls near the lower part of the settings list, where content behavior and generation settings are visible.
visible_ui_elements: Go back after copying or sharing
steps.system_response: The settings list continues downward and reveals lower settings categories.
steps.visual_feedback: Lower settings options and the Generation section appear.
steps.intent_task: Reach and review lower settings related to content behavior and barcode generation.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Settings screen remains visible near the lower part of the list with a back arrow in the top-left corner.
visible_ui_elements: Go back after copying or sharing
steps.system_response: The app returns to the Scan code screen.
steps.navigation_change: Settings screen to Scan code screen
steps.visual_feedback: The settings list disappears and the camera preview returns.
steps.intent_task: Leave settings and return to scanning.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Scan code screen is visible again with the live camera preview and scanner controls.
steps.visual_feedback: The camera preview and crop overlay are visible again.
steps.intent_task: Confirm the app has returned to the scanning view.

overall_flow: The user starts on the Scan code camera screen.
The user opens the overflow menu.
The user scrolls through scanner, feedback, history, forwarding, content, and generation settings.
The user returns to the Scan code screen.
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens on the Scan code screen with the camera preview active.
Step 2: The user opens the three-dot menu on the scan screen.
Step 3: The user selects Settings and the settings page opens.
Step 4: The user scrolls down to view scan behavior and feedback settings.
Step 5: The user continues scrolling through history, forwarding, and content settings.
Step 6: The user scrolls near the bottom of the settings list to view more content and generation options.
Step 7: The user goes back from Settings to the Scan code screen.
Step 8: The Scan code screen is visible again.
